name: K Increasing Subsequence 1
statement: For the given sequence A with n different elements find the number of increasing subsequences with k  elements.
inputFormat:
First line contains one integer n
Second line contains one integer k
following n lines contains elements of sequence
A[1]
A[2]
....A[n]
outputFormat: Print one number the andwer to question
constraints:
1. 1 <= n <= 10^5
2. 1 <= k <= 11
3. 1 <= A[i] <= n
4. Output may not fit in 32 bit signed integer
